authorization.reason: The owner explicitly authorized the more expensive C/D runs after being told that the frozen Phase-0 automatic-promotion gate did not pass.
not_authorized: B1 access before the y4n decision is committed

phase0_decision.interpretation: The frozen automatic-promotion rule failed and remains historically true. This contract is an explicit exploratory override, not a rewrite or retrospective pass.

allowed: candidate encoder comparison against the historical ImageNet reference
D versus C comparison of pre-pooling adjacent ordered-pair context under the same future objective
forbidden: confirmatory test of the frozen preregistration
proof that future prediction beats ordinary Celeste domain adaptation without Arm B
proof that the explicit signed-difference channels alone cause a D-versus-C difference

embargo.rule: forbidden for discovery, inventory construction, caching, pretraining, supervised fitting, inference, thresholding, calibration, selection, or diagnostics
other_exclusions: the entire y4nQHqYSObI video during cache construction and pretraining
embargo.y4n_export_policy: The whole y4nQHqYSObI video may be encoded only after C/D pretraining is terminal, solely to create the frozen downstream y4n evaluation features.

D.name: celeste_future_latent_ordered_pair
D.interpretation: Tests access to adjacent ordered-pair context before pooling; the redundant signed-difference slice is not separately isolated.

wild_provisional.role: masked unlabeled provisional video; decoded action values are never opened

local.role: corrected own-v3 masked video; engine-truth values are never opened

data.horizon_choice: Post-Phase-0 exploratory restriction to the registered offsets nearest the only secure action-specific signal (dash onset first visible at +1 and strongest at +3). This is not the frozen preregistration's horizon-pruning result.

motion_strata.definition: mean absolute masked-pixel luma endpoint difference
motion_strata.thresholds: separate training-population median within every source and horizon

cache.layout: NCHW-window memmap represented on disk as [window,offset,height,width,channel]

training.loss: mean per-example L1 between L2-normalized prediction and stop-gradient target latent

preflight.on_failure: preserve evidence and stop; do not resize, tune, or silently restart under a changed recipe

collapse_monitor.panel_balance: deterministic horizon-by-stratum cell counts differ by at most one; source composition follows validated eligible proportions

feature_export.D_boundary_policy: previous equals current at each session boundary; never cross a gap

downstream.architecture: unchanged 25.7M centered GRU over frozen 512-D features with post-pool deltas
downstream.evaluation: mapped y4n later-eight on identical support
primary_metrics: segment-bounded combined onset/release exact event F1
segment-bounded combined onset/release plus-or-minus-2-frame event F1
secondary_metrics: macro and per-key AP with prevalence
downstream.B1_policy: forbidden until the complete y4n C/D decision and checkpoint hashes are committed

promotion.reference_A: historical ImageNet encoder result; candidate comparison only because B is absent
promotion.D_vs_C_rule: D plus-or-minus-2 event F1 improves by at least 0.010 absolute, exact event F1 loses at most 0.002, and macro AP loses at most 0.005
promotion.replication: Any promoted recipe requires a separate authorization and must repeat the full SSL plus downstream pipeline for seeds 1 and 2.
